decision: Use the Paippalāda reading at each addressed locus. Preserve a distinct plural-preverb-free food clause, an adjacent sam clause with a different instrumental, a bare two-accusative clause, and the corroborating retention contact. No Śaunaka accent or textual possibility is transferred by recension alignment.
